name: NetBreaker
description: Local v2ray kernel runner: start and stop a SOCKS inbound, show the listen port, ping connectivity, and keep the last 10 log lines.

scripts.name: start
scripts.description: Start the local v2ray kernel listener

scripts.name: stop
scripts.description: Stop the local v2ray kernel process

scripts.name: ping
scripts.description: Probe the local inbound and a public TCP endpoint

scripts.name: ensure-kernel
scripts.description: Locate or download a user-local v2ray kernel into scripts/

scripts.name: v2ray
scripts.description: Locate the bundled kernel, or pass through arguments to it
